item.title: Autoregressive Neural Network Extrapolation of Quantum Spin Dynamics Across Time and Space
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hubert Pugzlys, Shreyas Varude, Sam Dillon, Huy Tran, Ta Tang, Brian Moritz 等8位作者
arXiv:2512.13103v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding the long-time dynamics of strongly correlated quantum matter remains a major challenge: as quantum entanglement grows during time evolution, conventional numerical methods become increasingly costly, limiting access to the long-range correlations and low-energy excitations that govern gapless systems. Here we show that these dynamical correlations can be extended beyond the accessible numerical window without explicitly evolving the underlying many-body wavefunction. We introduce an autoregressive machine-learning framework that enables the extrapolation of dynamical spin correlations in both time and space beyond the reach of conventional numerical methods. Trained on time-dependent density matrix renormalization group sim…

item.title: Machine learning topological defect formation: When are the defects made?
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fumika Suzuki, Ying Wai Li, Wojciech H. Zurek
arXiv:2508.20347v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological defects that form in a nonequilibrium second-order phase transition are presumably seeded by fluctuations of the order parameter in the vicinity of the critical point. Motivated by this conjecture that underlies the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM), we investigate whether machine learning (ML) can anticipate their locations from the fluctuations in the ``impulse regime'', the time interval when the evolution of the order parameter cannot keep up with the conditions imposed by the quench. Going beyond the conventional KZM focus on defect density, we show that a recurrent neural network can predict locations of topological defects from short-time dynamical data deep within the impulse regime. We thus demonstrate that defects are so…

item.title: Fixed-Dimensional Latent Flow for Generating Variable-Size 3D Molecules
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Weichi Yao, Cameron Gruich, Bryan R. Goldsmith, Yixin Wang
提出固定维度分子级潜变量流匹配框架，由自回归Transformer决定分子尺寸并生成原子类型、坐标及化学状态。在PCQM4Mv2上，模型通过率、有效新颖分子比例及目标性质命中率均表现突出。

item.title: Current-Driven Magnetization Switching via Zhang-Li Torque
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shuai Li, Maokang Shen, Liuyu Tang, Weiwei Lin, Kaiming Cai, Tao Wang 等8位作者
指出界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用在器件边缘产生磁化梯度，使Zhang–Li自旋转移力矩能够驱动确定性的场辅助磁化翻转。模拟表明，该机制可呈现类似自旋轨道力矩的极性控制和有效场特征。

item.title: 用于非均质固体力学的变分物理信息图神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Aashay Rajan Yadav, Amiya Prakash Das, Ratna Kumar Annabattula
本文提出一种无标签的变分物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN），通过离散化而非试探场表示材料非均质性，并在自适应共形网格图上最小化离散总势能。该方法无需罚项、界面权重或预设过渡宽度即可构造满足狄利克雷边界条件的界面表示。在二维和三维小应变弹性及有限应变Neo-Hookean超弹性测试中，其冯·米塞斯误差在广泛刚度对比范围内低于3.58%，但训练成本超过单次有限元求解一个数量级以上。

item.title: 生成式回放缓解量子架构搜索中的样本匮乏
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Akash Kundu, Amit Kumar Jaiswal, Sebastian Feld, Prayag Tiwari
本文提出GenQAS，一种由张量网络引导的强化学习框架，将固定的矩阵乘积态热启动与优先级生成式回放相结合。学习到的局部状态转移模型根据真实状态—动作种子生成合成电路转移，并在双重深度Q网络更新中与真实经验混合。6至12量子比特化学哈密顿量基准和15量子比特横场伊辛模型实验表明，该方法提升了固定预算下的成功概率；在12量子比特任务中相较被动回放最高提升7倍，在含噪6量子比特BeH2迁移实验中达到化学精度所需步数减少92.7%。

item.title: 用于交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xue Qiu, Jianli Xiao
本文提出一种用于交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型（DF-LLM），由时空嵌入模块、时空融合模块和大语言模型骨干组成。该模型通过图卷积融合空间拓扑与动态依赖，并采用差异化参数适配、上下文聚合注意力和残差连接，以提升交通数据适应性及全局依赖建模能力。在四个数据集上的实验表明，DF-LLM在各项指标上均取得了更优性能。

item.title: Generating is not discovering: a pre-registered physics judge for AI-proposed superconductors, calibrated on six known superconductors and one negative control
item.description:
📚 arXiv

item.title: 具有非共线自旋-轨道耦合的扭转结构中的莫尔拓扑
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xilong Xu, Liangtao Peng, Shaffique Adam, Li Yang
本文提出一种获得拓扑莫尔微带的新机制，基于具有非共线自旋-轨道耦合的中心对称II型自旋-轨道耦合双层体系，而不依赖谷自由度或六角晶格对称性。层间杂化形成局域赝能隙和高度局域的贝里曲率，扭转后可重构为孤立的拓扑微带。作者以四方Dresselhaus自旋-轨道耦合HgI2及经机器学习优化的PbI2为例，指出更强自旋-轨道耦合有助于获得更窄、更孤立的微带，并支持关联磁性及可调量子自旋霍尔和陈绝缘相。

item.title: Modeling financial time series with φ⁴ quantum field theory
item.description:

item.title: Geometric Approach to Zero-Memory Quantum Dot Reservoir Computing
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bongsu Kim, Oscar Lee, Sangjun Jeon, Kun Woo Kim
提出以空间输入节点替代物理储备池内禀时间记忆的量子点储备计算方案。在短弛豫时间、多端量子点系统中引入可调外显记忆，并在混沌预测和非线性变换任务上取得较好性能。

item.title: 一种用于对角加权矩阵函数的量子启发去量子化方法：应用于带优化随机特征的学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Natsuto Isogai, Mio Murao, Hayata Yamasaki
本文提出一种经典算法，用于去量子化一类现有框架无法覆盖的量子机器学习采样器。该方法通过采样高权重索引、将变换约化为小型主块，并输出具有算子范数保证的稀疏经典表示，解决待求逆矩阵无法直接获得采样访问的问题。应用于优化随机特征学习后，该方法得到具有规定精度且运行时间呈多项式相关的经典采样器，表明量子块编码背后的分解本身可以提供足够的经典结构。

item.title: 可解释性助手：用于解释能源消耗模型的对话式可解释人工智能界面
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rodion Krjutškov, Eduard Barbu, Nikos Sakkas, Sofia Yfanti
本文提出开源的可解释性助手，一种利用现代大语言模型函数调用能力的对话式可解释人工智能系统，用于解释能源消耗预测模型。该系统能够灵活理解自然语言意图，支持不同机器学习问题类型，且无需针对任务进行微调，意图解析准确率达到94%，高于此前方法的76.8%。与传统可解释人工智能仪表板的比较评估表明，该系统具有更好的可用性和稳定的任务准确率，所有参与评估的能源领域专家均偏好对话式界面。

item.title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ken Chen, Maneesha Perera, Wei Wang, Sachith Seneviratne, Hansani Weeratunge, Saman Halgamuge
提出SolCloudLLM，将天空图像斑块与时间序列斑块对齐，并通过双向多模态融合输入大语言模型。SIRTA和SKIPP'D数据集实验显示，各预测时域MSE均优于最佳基线，最大相对降幅达25.4%，收益主要出现在多云条件下。

item.title: 知识体系综述：通过可解释人工智能对机器学习发起的隐私攻击
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abdullah Caglar Oksuz, Anisa Halimi, Erman Ayday
本文系统梳理了利用机器学习解释实施模型提取、成员推断和模型反演的25项研究，并将属性推断视为部分反演。研究区分了模型知识与解释获取方式，归纳出目标模型发布、攻击者推导、二次披露、特权访问和已发布全局工件五种路径。分析表明，隐私风险取决于暴露的解释信号、获取方式、攻击目标及攻击者已有知识，因此解释隐私应被视为端到端的信息披露问题，并针对不同获取路径和受保护资产设计防御措施。

item.title: Correlation enhanced altermagnetism mediated by spin-lattice coupling in CrSb
item.description:

👤 Charmi Bhalani, Banasree Sadhukhan
arXiv:2609.11346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, making them promising platforms for spintronic applications. While the symmetry and multipolar origins of nonrelativistic altermagnetic spin splitting (NRASS) are well established, the role of electronic correlations and spin-lattice coupling (SLC) in controlling NRASS remain unexplored. In particular, SLC provides a direct pathway for tuning altermagnetism through lattice degrees of freedom. Here we first investigate the role of electronic correlations on altermagnetic strength in NiAs-type material CrSb using density functional theory (DFT), DFT+U, and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). We find that increasing electronic correlations substantially enha…

item.title: Importance of nonlinear long-range electron-phonon interaction for the carrier mobility of anharmonic halide perovskites
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Matthew Houtput, Ingvar Zappacosta, William Wenborn, Serghei Klimin, Samuel Poncé, Jacques Tempere 等7位作者
arXiv:2603.10954v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interaction between the electrons and the lattice vibrations in a solid is responsible for various important effects, such as formation of polarons, temperature dependent bandgaps, phonon-limited carrier transport, and conventional superconductivity. Most works assume a linear electron-phonon interaction, where the electron only interacts with one phonon at a time. However, the validity of this assumption has not been verified in polar anharmonic materials, where large ionic displacements may invalidate the assumption of linear interaction. Here, we show that nonlinear electron-phonon interactions contribute significantly to the finite-temperature electron mobility of the inorganic lead halide perovskite CsPbI₃. The effect of nonline…

item.title: High-Temperature ferromagnetism from site-selective filling in (Fe,Ni)₆₋δGeTe₂
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tyler L. Werner, Jonathan T. Reichanadter, Xiang Chen, Pranab K. Nag, Luna Y. Liu, Yu-Tsun Shao 等26位作者
arXiv:2609.11862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of high-temperature ferromagnetism in the metallic van der Waals (vdW) system Fe_NGeTe₂ has brought two-dimensional (2D) magnets into technologically relevant temperature scales. Specifically at N = 5, dilution of magnetic moments by nickel substitution counterintuitively achieves a record high Curie temperature of 478~K. Unraveling the origin of this nickel-substitution-induced enhancement is complicated by the compound's structural complexity, coexistent itinerant and local magnetic contributions, and mesoscopic compositional domains. Through coordinated structural and electronic characterization, we identify that the high-T_C magnetic phase arises from a strain-stabilized Fe₆GeTe₂ nano-precipitate. Combining first-principles…

item.title: Skyrmion nucleus resolves the Landauer paradox
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiyuan Yang, Denan Li, Shi Liu
arXiv:2609.11551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric switching is among the most fundamental and widely studied symmetry-breaking processes in physics. However, the Landauer paradox asserts that an ideal single-domain ferroelectric should be kinetically unswitchable, because a three-dimensional reversed nucleus would carry a prohibitive depolarization penalty, leading to unphysically large coercive field (the electric field required to switch the polarization). Here we show that this long-standing paradox is resolved by topology. In defect-free PbTiO3, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the intrinsic critical nucleus is a three-dimensional polar skyrmion. Its continuous polarization rotation and Néel-type boundary walls self-compensate bound charge, suppressin…

item.title: Interplay of spin-lattice and electronic coupling far above Neel ordering in 2D antiferromagnetic CrPS4 and its interface manifestation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Divya Jangra, Binoy Krishna De, Mukesh Kumar Dasoundhi, Sourav Chowdhury, Pragati Sharma, Kartick Biswas 等16位作者
在CrPS₄中发现远高于 Néel 温度的自旋—声子—电子强耦合态，拉曼光谱显示自旋—声子耦合可持续至约120 K，并伴随局域晶格畸变。CrPS₄/In₂Se₃异质结构中，该磁异常还显著调制邻近层的晶格动力学。

item.title: Breaking Water at Graphene Defects
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Samuel G. H. Brookes, IniOluwa C. Popoola, Fabian Berger, Kara D. Fong, Angelos Michaelides, Christoph Schran

item.title: Piezomagnetism in a model cubic noncollinear altermagnet
item.description:

arXiv:2609.11816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets constitute a distinct class of magnetic materials that combine compensated magnetic order with spin-polarized electronic bands, hence carrying characteristics of both antiferromagnets and ferromagnets. Piezomagnetism - the linear relationship between lattice strain and a net magnetic moment - has emerged as smoking-gun evidence of altermagnetism that distinguishes it from antiferromagnetism. Here, we uncover a large piezomagnetic response in MnTe2, a cubic altermagnet with a noncollinear spin arrangement and weak spin-orbit coupling. We combine dilatometry with nuclear magnetic resonance, a bulk local probe, to observe signatures of both direct and inverse piezomagnetism consistent with symmetry considerations and first-principl…

item.title: Phase-Controlled Majorana Zero Modes in Altermagnetic Topological-Insulator Josephson Junctions

item.title: Effective Ionic Valence and Local Magnetic Moment in Kagome Superconductors

item.title: High-fidelity k·p representations of first-principles electronic band structures through covariant renormalization

item.title: Geometric Ginzburg-Landau theory of charge ordering and commensurability
item.description:

We derive an effective Ginzburg-Landau theory including uncharted contributions and, as a highlight, discover a general criterion for both CDW formation and commensurability transitions where underlying electron-phonon interactions manifest purely as electroni…

item.title: Hilbert-space selected switch of helical edges in an artificial quantum Hall insulator

提出菱形—十二边形二维紧束缚晶格，零磁通下因破坏性干涉产生三个平带和紧致局域态。调节磁通可诱导非零整数陈数，并形成可调输运共振与传输抑制，为光子晶格和超冷原子体系提供研究平台。

item.title: Self-Assembled H2NC Molecular Lattices as a Platform for Tunable Quantum Superlattices
item.description:

item.title: Spin-orbit-entangled Jᵣₘ ₑff=frac12 magnetism and unconventional spin freezing in the bond-disordered pyrochlore antiferromagnet NaCdCo₂F₇

item.title: 交错磁体中集体磁振子与轨道子的统一理论
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bishal Das, Chanchal K. Barman, Aftab Alam
交错磁性是一种净磁化为零但具有动量依赖自旋劈裂的共线磁相，其可由不等价的非磁环境或强关联诱导的轨道有序稳定。本文在装饰方格子上建立扩展的Kugel-Khomskii自旋-轨道模型，统一描述这两种机制，并预测相互不杂化但彼此关联、具有特征性手性劈裂的磁振子和轨道子激发。劈裂分别源于晶格环境差异及轨道有序导致的交换各向异性；有限温研究还表明，经典蒙特卡洛模拟可恢复预期的连续二级相变行为。

item.title: 超自旋铁磁体
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hai-Yang Ma, Yuanchang Li, Hu Xu, Shengbai Zhang, Jin-Feng Jia
